title.zh: 同样是糖，为什么检验不同？
title.en: Why do sugars give different tests?

question.zh: 同样是糖，为什么检验不同？
question.en: Why do sugars give different tests?

description.zh: 追踪葡萄糖开环与两电子还原，比较自由端、水解产物和检验条件怎样改变证据。
description.en: Follow glucose ring opening and two-electron reduction; compare free ends, hydrolysis products and valid test conditions.

addSources.title: OpenStax: cyclic structures and ring–chain equilibrium

translations.同样是糖，为什么检验不同？: Why do sugars give different tests?
translations.追踪葡萄糖开环与两电子还原，比较自由端、水解产物和检验条件怎样改变证据。: Follow glucose ring opening and two-electron reduction; compare free ends, hydrolysis products and valid test conditions.

cues.title: 先观察溶解状态
cues.caption: 葡萄糖与蔗糖溶解；淀粉受热糊化。
cues.captionEn: Glucose and sucrose dissolve; warmed starch forms a paste.
cues.zh: 活动先观察样品本身。葡萄糖和蔗糖的晶体逐渐溶入水中；淀粉在冷水里保留颗粒，加热后出现糊状体系。固体不再明显可见，可能来自溶解，也可能涉及颗粒吸水与结构改变，不能把淀粉糊简单说成同样的分子真溶液。
cues.en: Start with the samples themselves. Glucose and sucrose crystals dissolve in water. Starch retains particles in cool water and forms a paste on warming. A solid becoming less visible can involve different processes: dissolution, swelling and structural change are not interchangeable. Starch paste is not simply the same kind of molecular solution.

cues.title: 环里的醛基怎样出现？
cues.caption: 环状葡萄糖开环，醛端还原银试剂。
cues.captionEn: Glucose opens its ring; the aldehyde end reduces silver reagent.
cues.zh: 银镜是金属银。追踪葡萄糖的第一号碳：水中多数分子成环，但能开环露出醛端。醛端被氧化，银得到电子。开链分子消耗后，环链平衡继续补充，所以少量开链形式不等于只能产生少量银。
cues.en: The mirror is metallic silver. Follow carbon one: most glucose molecules form rings, but ring opening exposes an aldehyde end. That end is oxidised while silver gains electrons. As open chains react, equilibrium replenishes them. A small open-chain population does not limit the result to a tiny silver deposit.

cues.title: 电子从糖转移给铜
cues.caption: 醛端失电子，铜得到电子形成 Cu₂O。
cues.captionEn: The aldehyde end loses electrons; copper gains them in Cu₂O.
cues.zh: 另一份葡萄糖遇到铜试剂，形成砖红色氧化亚铜。仍是同一个醛端失去两个电子，两个铜中心各得到一个，正二价变正一价。试剂必须处于合适的碱性并加热。酸性样品没有沉淀，不能据此判定没有还原糖。
cues.en: A separate glucose sample forms brick-red copper one oxide. Again the aldehyde end loses two electrons; two copper centres each gain one, changing from plus two to plus one. The test needs suitable alkalinity and warming. No precipitate in an acidic mixture cannot establish that reducing sugar is absent.

cues.title: 检验食物中的淀粉
cues.caption: 碘显蓝色，提供淀粉仍在的证据。
cues.captionEn: The blue iodine response indicates remaining starch.
cues.zh: 碘液落在含淀粉的食物切片上，局部出现蓝色。这个证据与淀粉链形成的有色体系有关，用来判断样品中是否仍有淀粉。它不是检测所有糖的通用方法，也不是银镜或铜试剂检验的同一种反应。下一步要把淀粉证据和水解产物证据分开。
cues.en: Iodine solution stains a starch-containing food slice blue. This response involves the starch-chain complex and helps detect remaining starch. It is not a universal test for every carbohydrate, nor the same reaction as the silver or copper tests. We will keep evidence of starch separate from evidence of its hydrolysis products.

cues.title: 先水解，再调节环境
cues.caption: 长链水解；冷却并调至碱性后检验。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolyse the chain; cool and make alkaline before testing.
cues.zh: 淀粉在酸催化条件下水解，最终可以得到葡萄糖。画面用同一组单元表示净变化，实际还会经过多种较短的糖链。接下来有一个不能跳过的条件转换：水解液冷却后，需要调至碱性。若把酸性水解液直接当作合适的铜检验体系，结果就不能正常解释。
cues.en: Acid-catalysed starch hydrolysis can ultimately yield glucose. The same unit symbols track the net change, while real hydrolysis passes through shorter chains. An essential condition change follows: cool the hydrolysate and make it alkaline. Treating the acidic hydrolysate as a valid copper-test mixture would make the observation unreliable.

cues.title: 比较水解前后
cues.caption: 水解释放还原端；两种检验可以同为阳性。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolysis releases reducing ends; both tests can be positive.
cues.zh: 两支试管分别来自水解前后。在本教材的普通定性条件下，淀粉原样不出现明显的砖红色证据；充分水解后的样品可以出现。长链并非绝对没有还原端，而是相同质量下端基数量很少。自由探索做部分水解时，碘检验与铜检验可以同时阳性，表示淀粉和还原性产物共存。
cues.en: Compare separate samples before and after hydrolysis. Under the textbook’s ordinary qualitative conditions, untreated starch shows no clear brick-red result, while the hydrolysed sample does. Long chains are not absolutely devoid of reducing ends; there are few per unit mass. Partial hydrolysis can leave both iodine and copper tests positive, indicating coexistence.

cues.title: 保留未水解对照
cues.caption: 条件相同，原蔗糖没有明显阳性。
cues.captionEn: Matched conditions; untreated sucrose gives no clear positive.
cues.zh: 蔗糖同样能溶于水，但溶解不等于具有还原性。保持铜试剂、碱性和加热条件一致，未经水解的蔗糖不出现明显砖红色沉淀。这支试管作为对照，帮助排除只要糖有甜味、能溶解就会给出同样检验结果的误解。
cues.en: Sucrose dissolves in water too, but dissolution does not establish reducing behaviour. With the same copper reagent, alkaline conditions and warming, untreated sucrose produces no clear brick-red precipitate. Keep this control: being soluble or sweet does not guarantee the same chemical-test result.

cues.title: 检验蔗糖水解产物
cues.caption: 水解改变组成，产物可还原试剂。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolysis changes the composition; products reduce the reagent.
cues.zh: 蔗糖水解后得到葡萄糖和果糖。冷却并调至适合的碱性，再作同样检验，出现砖红色沉淀。这里不能把结果解释成原来的蔗糖突然成了还原糖，而是样品组成已经改变。果糖也能在碱性检验中通过结构转化表现还原性，因此阳性并不只对应原来就有醛基的分子。
cues.en: Hydrolysis changes sucrose into glucose and fructose. After cooling and establishing suitable alkaline conditions, the same test gives a brick-red precipitate. The composition has changed; the result does not make the original sucrose a reducing sugar. Fructose can also give a reducing response through structural rearrangement in the alkaline test.

cues.title: 比较蔗糖与麦芽糖
cues.caption: 分子式相同，可反应的端基却不同。
cues.captionEn: Same formula, different available reducing ends.
cues.zh: 探究把蔗糖与麦芽糖并排比较，两者都先不水解。它们的分子式相同，却不必给出相同的化学性质。保持条件相同，麦芽糖可以显示还原性，而蔗糖原样没有明显阳性。画面用同一套试剂账避免凭标题换颜色；差别来自模型中可参与反应的端基。
cues.en: The inquiry compares sucrose and maltose without first hydrolysing either. Their molecular formulas match, but their chemical behaviour need not. Under matched conditions maltose can give reducing evidence, unlike untreated sucrose. The same reagent account drives both drawings; their difference comes from the available reducing groups, not a title-dependent colour swap.

cues.title: 解释连接部位
cues.caption: 麦芽糖保留自由端，能与开链醛式平衡。
cues.captionEn: Maltose retains a free end that equilibrates with an aldehyde.
cues.zh: 用简化的环形符号看连接位置。蔗糖的葡萄糖和果糖都把关键异头位点用于连接，不能直接保留可开环的半缩醛端。麦芽糖还有一个自由端，可以与开链醛式建立平衡。因此不能只数有几个糖环，要看连接占用了哪些位点。符号图不表示完整立体结构。
cues.en: The ring symbols now show linkage positions. Sucrose uses both anomeric sites in its connection, leaving no free hemiacetal end. Maltose retains one such end, which can equilibrate with an open-chain aldehyde form. Counting sugar rings is therefore insufficient; the occupied sites matter. These symbols show connectivity, not complete stereochemistry.

cues.title: 观察纤维素处理
cues.caption: 特定酸处理使纤维素水解，释放葡萄糖。
cues.captionEn: Specific acid treatment hydrolyses cellulose, releasing glucose.
cues.zh: 脱脂棉主要提供纤维素。教材使用特定的酸处理，使纤维结构被破坏并发生水解，最终能得到葡萄糖。它和淀粉都由葡萄糖单元组成，但结构不同，不能把相同温和条件下的快慢视为一样。图中纤维逐渐减少，单糖符号出现，只表达净转化方向。
cues.en: Cotton provides cellulose. The textbook uses a specific acid treatment to disrupt fibres and hydrolyse their chains, ultimately yielding glucose. Cellulose and starch share glucose building blocks but have different structures; they should not be assumed to hydrolyse equally readily under mild conditions. Fading fibres and appearing units show the net transformation only.

cues.title: 完成纤维素产物检验
cues.caption: 碱性、加热后，检出还原性产物。
cues.captionEn: With alkalinity and warming, reducing products are detected.
cues.zh: 纤维素处理后的液体同样不能省略条件调节。先中和酸，并使体系呈碱性，再加入铜盐并加热，才能按教材方法解释氧化亚铜的出现。还原性证据支持水解后出现了能还原试剂的产物，但单凭这一项不能证明产物绝对纯净，或原来的纤维素已经百分之百水解。
cues.en: The cellulose-treated liquid needs the same condition check. Neutralise acid and establish alkalinity before adding copper reagent and warming. The copper oxide evidence supports the presence of reducing products after hydrolysis. This single test does not demonstrate absolute product purity or prove that all of the original cellulose has been hydrolysed.

question.zh: 多数分子是环状，葡萄糖为什么还能形成银镜？
question.en: If most glucose is cyclic, why can it still form a silver mirror?

lead.zh: 从银镜和砖红色沉淀回到同一个C₁，追踪开环、醛端氧化与金属中心得到电子。
lead.en: Follow the mirror and brick-red precipitate back to the same C₁: ring opening, aldehyde oxidation and electron gain by metal centres.

principle.zh: 葡萄糖的环状半缩醛与少量开链醛式平衡；开链形式被消耗后可继续补充。醛端净失去两个电子，两个Ag(I)或Cu(II)中心各得到一个。现象支持还原性，不能单独证明样品一定是葡萄糖。
principle.en: Cyclic glucose hemiacetals equilibrate with a small open-chain aldehyde population that can be replenished as it reacts. Net loss of two electrons from the aldehyde end reduces two Ag(I) or Cu(II) centres. The observations support reducing behaviour without uniquely identifying glucose.

question.zh: 酸性样品没有出现砖红色沉淀，能否判定没有还原糖？
question.en: Does no brick-red precipitate in an acidic sample prove that reducing sugar is absent?

explanation.zh: 不能。铜检验需要合适的碱性、试剂与加热条件，酸性体系的无沉淀是无效条件下的观察。先使条件成立，再比较样品；金属试剂不足也会限制产物量。
explanation.en: No. The copper test needs suitable alkalinity, reagent and warming. An observation from an invalid acidic mixture is not a valid negative. Establish the conditions before comparing samples; limited metal reagent can also limit the product.

question.zh: 多数分子是环状，葡萄糖为什么还能形成银镜？
question.en: If most glucose is cyclic, why can it still form a silver mirror?

lead.zh: 从银镜和砖红色沉淀回到同一个C₁，追踪开环、醛端氧化与金属中心得到电子。
lead.en: Follow the mirror and brick-red precipitate back to the same C₁: ring opening, aldehyde oxidation and electron gain by metal centres.

principle.zh: 葡萄糖的环状半缩醛与少量开链醛式平衡；开链形式被消耗后可继续补充。醛端净失去两个电子，两个Ag(I)或Cu(II)中心各得到一个。现象支持还原性，不能单独证明样品一定是葡萄糖。
principle.en: Cyclic glucose hemiacetals equilibrate with a small open-chain aldehyde population that can be replenished as it reacts. Net loss of two electrons from the aldehyde end reduces two Ag(I) or Cu(II) centres. The observations support reducing behaviour without uniquely identifying glucose.

question.en: Does no brick-red precipitate in an acidic sample prove that reducing sugar is absent?

explanation.zh: 不能。铜检验需要合适的碱性、试剂与加热条件，酸性体系的无沉淀是无效条件下的观察。先使条件成立，再比较样品；金属试剂不足也会限制产物量。
explanation.en: No. The copper test needs suitable alkalinity, reagent and warming. An observation from an invalid acidic mixture is not a valid negative. Establish the conditions before comparing samples; limited metal reagent can also limit the product.

question.zh: 淀粉的蓝色还在，铜检验为什么也能阳性？
question.en: Why can a blue starch response coexist with a positive copper test?

lead.zh: 分别观察长链的碘显色和水解产物的还原性，沿同一组单元理解两份样品的证据。
lead.en: Separate the iodine evidence for long chains from the reducing evidence of hydrolysis products, following the same building units.

principle.zh: 碘显色与还原糖检验回答不同问题。水解使长链转为更小的糖，能反应的端基数量增加；酸水解液必须冷却并调到合适的碱性，才能解释铜检验。
principle.en: Iodine and reducing-sugar tests answer different questions. Hydrolysis produces smaller sugars and increases available reactive ends. Cool an acid hydrolysate and establish suitable alkalinity before interpreting the copper test.

question.zh: 只水解了一部分，另取两份样品分别检验会怎样？
question.en: What would separate iodine and copper tests show after only partial hydrolysis?

explanation.zh: 可以同时阳性：剩余淀粉提供蓝色证据，已经生成的还原性产物形成Cu₂O。两种阳性并不矛盾，也不能据此给出精确水解百分比；试剂应在分取的样品中分别使用。
explanation.en: Both can be positive: remaining starch gives the blue response, while reducing products form Cu₂O. This is consistent with coexistence, not an exact hydrolysis percentage. Use separate sample portions for the two tests.

question.zh: 分子式相同，蔗糖和麦芽糖为什么检验不同？
question.en: Why do sucrose and maltose test differently despite sharing a formula?

lead.zh: 先在相同条件下比较两支试管，再追踪麦芽糖自由端开环时仍保留的C₄—O—G连接。
lead.en: Compare matched tests, then follow maltose’s free end as it opens while its C₄–O–G connection remains intact.

principle.zh: 蔗糖的两个异头位点都参与糖苷连接；麦芽糖保留自由半缩醛端，可以与开链醛式平衡。因此还原性取决于可反应的结构，不能只看分子式、甜味或糖环数量。
principle.en: Sucrose uses both anomeric sites in its glycosidic link. Maltose retains a free hemiacetal end that equilibrates with an aldehyde. Reducing behaviour therefore depends on available structure, not formula, sweetness or ring count alone.

question.zh: 把蔗糖先水解，再在同样的有效条件下检验，结果应怎样改变？
question.en: What should change if sucrose is hydrolysed before repeating the same valid test?

explanation.zh: 水解生成葡萄糖和果糖，改变了样品组成；碱性检验中可出现还原性证据。果糖可在碱性中转化为醛糖，阳性不能倒推原蔗糖具有自由醛端。
explanation.en: Hydrolysis changes the sample into glucose and fructose, allowing a reducing response in the alkaline test. Fructose can rearrange to aldoses in base; the result does not give the original sucrose a free aldehyde end.

question.zh: 棉纤维里，为什么能检出还原性产物？
question.en: How can cotton fibres yield reducing products?

lead.zh: 从纤维中的葡萄糖单元出发，跟随特定酸处理、水解与检验条件的转换。
lead.en: Follow the glucose units in cellulose through the specified acid treatment, hydrolysis and the change to valid test conditions.

principle.zh: 纤维素由葡萄糖单元组成，教材的特定酸处理使其水解；长链中每单位质量的还原端很少，水解后能反应的小分子增多。产物液需要中和至碱性并按条件加热检验。
principle.en: Cellulose contains glucose units released by the textbook’s specific acid treatment. Long chains have few reducing ends per unit mass; hydrolysis produces more reactive small molecules. The product mixture must be made alkaline and warmed under the assay conditions.

question.zh: 铜检验阳性，是否证明所有纤维都已水解、产物只有葡萄糖？
question.en: Does a positive copper test prove complete hydrolysis and pure glucose?

explanation.zh: 不能。阳性只支持存在能够还原试剂的产物，残余纤维、其他组分或不完全水解仍可能存在。普通热水也不能替代教材的特定处理条件。
explanation.en: No. A positive response supports the presence of reducing products, while residual fibres, other components and incomplete hydrolysis may remain. Ordinary hot water does not replace the specified treatment.

question.zh: 糖都能溶解或变成糊，为什么检验结果却不同？
question.en: Why do soluble sugars and starch paste give different test results?

lead.zh: 从溶解与糊化进入环链结构、电子收支和水解前后对照，区分样品组成与检验条件。
lead.en: Move from dissolution and paste formation to ring–chain structure, electron balance and before/after hydrolysis controls.

principle.zh: 物理状态不能决定还原性。可开环的端基支持醛端氧化和金属还原；糖苷连接可能占用这些位置。水解改变组成，酸碱与加热条件决定检验是否有效，碘显色则提供另一类证据。
principle.en: Physical appearance does not determine reducing behaviour. Available hemiacetal ends support aldehyde oxidation and metal reduction; glycosidic links can occupy those sites. Hydrolysis changes composition, assay conditions determine validity, and iodine supplies a different kind of evidence.

question.zh: 同一样品同时碘阳性、铜阳性，或者加更多糖却不再增多沉淀，如何解释？
question.en: How can both tests be positive, or extra sugar fail to increase the precipitate?

explanation.zh: 前者可以来自剩余淀粉与还原性产物共存；后者可以来自金属试剂已经耗尽。先区分检测对象，再核对组成、条件与限制试剂，不能只凭一次颜色给样品下唯一结论。
explanation.en: The first can reflect remaining starch alongside reducing products; the second can reflect exhaustion of metal reagent. Identify what each test detects, then check composition, conditions and the limiting reagent before interpreting a colour.
